visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a dark blue t-shirt stands before a glass door. He holds a white mug to his mouth and drinks while looking down at a black smartphone in his other hand. Suddenly, his eyes widen, and he spits a long stream of water out of his mouth in shock. Bright yellow subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame. (2) A rapid series of cuts follows. First, a close-up of a person wearing a motorcycle helmet looking upward at a tall building. Next, a first-person perspective of hands pushing open double glass doors into a modern office. Finally, a sequence of cuts moves through an office hallway to a public restroom, ending with the man in the blue shirt sitting on a toilet in a small beige-tiled stall, holding his head in distress while talking on his phone. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor park on a sunny day. A different man in a white t-shirt and light blue jeans sits cross-legged on a patch of green grass. In the distant background, a massive white classical stone arch with horse statues on top is visible under a clear blue sky with light clouds. He smiles broadly while holding a phone to his right ear. (4) The camera zooms in closer on the man in the white shirt. He leans down to pick up a small, dark brown fragment of soil from the grass. He mimics sprinkling something over it with his fingers and then places the fragment into his mouth, chewing with a look of mock delight and intense excitement. He continues to talk into the phone while laughing, looking directly at the camera at the very end.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in an indoor setting with glass doors and a residential feel. It then transitions through a modern office with glass partitions and a shelving unit holding various figurines, followed by a standard beige-tiled public restroom. The latter half is set in a large urban park with a prominent historical white triumphal arch (Arco della Pace style) and green lawns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, comedic synthesizer BGM with a strong percussive beat begins immediately. A sharp, watery splashing SFX is heard as the first character spits. No vocals are present yet. (2) Frantic male vocals repeatedly shout "Lǎo bǎn" (Boss) with high arousal and a sense of urgency. Rapid hard cuts in the audio timeline match the visual montage, accompanied by the mechanical clacking of doors and the hollow thud of a toilet lid opening. (3) The BGM continues as a phone ringtone/pickup sound effect triggers. A frantic male voice in the foreground ("Jie diànhuà a") exhibits high vocal strain and anxiety. Soft background noise of a bathroom stall is audible. (4) The audio transitions to an outdoor environment with a noticeable ambient noise floor of wind and distant bird chirps. A second male voice, deeper and much calmer ("Wei, Jian Wen"), responds with friendly intonation. The frantic first voice continues to plead in the background through a simulated phone-filter effect. (5) The second male voice speaks excitedly with high pitch variability, describing a "big secret." A distinct percussive "crunch" and chewing sound effect is layered in as he describes eating dirt. Loud, high-arousal male laughter concludes the segment over the persistent upbeat BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> Linear: Hook -> Panic Sequence -> Reveal -> Humorous Payoff.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic sketch satirizing the emotional despair of stock market investors during a crash. It uses the visual metaphor of 'eating dirt' (a common Chinese slang term for being broke/having no money for food) to show a boss who has lost so much that he is literally tasting soil in a park and pretending it tastes like OREO cookies to cope with the loss.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses color puns; in the Taiwan stock market, 'green' signifies a drop in price. The 'Boss' sitting in a 'green' park is a literal and figurative play on the market crash.
